span.label: Training on forces roughly doubles the computational cost, because forces require a full forward and backward pass through the energy model.
span.note: what this limits: the force-training results, which are not free: WE EXPECT TO SEE IMPROVED GENERALIZATION, HOWEVER, AT A COMPUTATIONAL COST
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Performance on the new ISO17 benchmark, which combines chemical and conformational variation, is only promising rather than solved.
span.note: what this limits: the ISO17 benchmark result: WHILE WE ACHIEVE PROMISING RESULTS ON THIS NEW BENCHMARK, MODELING CHEMICAL AND CONFORMATIONAL VARIATIONS REMAINS DIFFICULT AND NEEDS FURTHER IMPROVEMENT
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A whole class of competing methods is excluded from force training by its REPRESENTATION - discrete binning and one-hot bond types - which makes their energy surface discontinuous.
span.note: what this limits: a comparison of this model against circular fingerprints, graph convolutions or message-passing networks on forces: those methods cannot be trained with forces at all, because discrete binning or one-hot bond types put discontinuities in their potential energy surface
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The main benchmark contains only equilibrium molecules, where the force term the paper exists to predict is zero by definition.
span.note: what this limits: a QM9 result as evidence about force prediction: QM9 holds only equilibrium molecules, so the forces there are zero by definition and are not predicted at all
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A named competitor is ruled out of one benchmark entirely, and its scaling behaviour is given as quadratic in both atoms and examples.
span.note: what this limits: GDML as a baseline: its kernel matrix grows quadratically in both the number of atoms and the number of examples, and it is stated elsewhere in the paper that it cannot be used for the molecular-dynamics predictions
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: SchNet uses continuous-filter convolutional layers to model atoms at their precise off-grid positions, yielding a joint model of total energy and interatomic forces that respects quantum-chemical principles and reaches state-of-the-art accuracy.
